description: The line chart, titled “Ablation Study on HateXplain Dataset,” illustrates how three performance metrics—Precision (purple line with circular markers), Recall (light blue line with circular markers), and F1-score (brown line with circular markers)—vary across five model variants of MS-FSLHate: “Full model (Ours),” “w/o Prompt,” “w/o Augmentation,” “w/o Attention,” and “w/o Prompt & Augmentation.” The x-axis, labeled “Model Variants,” is categorical and lists these five configurations in order. The y-axis, labeled “Metric (%)”, is linear and ranges from 56% to 66%, with major gridlines and tick labels at 58%, 60%, 62%, 64%, and 66%. For Precision, the score starts at 65.78% for the full model, drops to 61.06% without prompt, rises to 62.22% without augmentation, increases further to 64.06% without attention, and peaks at 65.44% without both prompt and augmentation. Recall begins at 65.46% for the full model, falls sharply to 59.64% without prompt, rebounds to 63.75% without augmentation, declines to 59.17% without attention, and drops to its lowest point of 56.82% without prompt and augmentation. The F1-score starts at 65.49% for the full model, decreases to 60.16% without prompt, rises to 62.63% without augmentation, falls to 59.67% without attention, and ends at 57.74% without prompt and augmentation. Each data point is explicitly labeled with its numerical value.
